scene: The ballerina leaps into your mitten, revealing three departing transit passes.
picture: Flat side view along the snowy edge of town. Far left, a glass-bottomed boat bobs at a canal dock. Centre-left, the boy in his orange puffer vest holds a tiny ballerina. Up high, a colorful hot-air balloon floats, tethered to a post. Far right, an icy chairlift terminal waits with a swinging wooden bench.
shown: a glass-bottomed canal boat moored at the stone dock on the far left
a tethered hot-air balloon with an open wicker basket up high
